# Agrawal Khandelwal & Associates LLP

> Chartered Accountant (CA) firm for NRIs and cross-border businesses, with offices in Nashik and Sillod, Maharashtra, India. Founded in 2023. Core practice: NRI taxation and FEMA (returns, property sales, lower TDS certificates, repatriation, DTAA), transfer pricing (Form 3CEB, benchmarking, documentation), international taxation (DTAA, POEM, UAE corporate tax, US LLC and C-Corp compliance for Indian founders), plus company incorporation, ROC compliance and statutory audit. The firm does not take on GST or routine domestic income tax work. Serves clients across India and in the UAE and the US. Partners: CA Mehul Agrawal (Nashik office; NRI, transfer pricing and international taxation; UAE Corporate Taxation certified) and CA Rupesh Khandelwal (Sillod office; statutory and internal audit, company compliance; prior experience at Deloitte).

## Firm

- [About](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/about): Partner bios, credentials, and firm background.
- [Services overview](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/services): All three practice groups: NRI Taxation, International Tax & Transfer Pricing, Companies & Startups.
- [Contact](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/contact): Office addresses, email, and consultation booking.
- [Book a consultation](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/consult): Free 15-minute intro call (short form, then pick a slot) or a paid 30-minute advice call. Pages expose WebMCP tools `get_consultation_options` and `request_free_call` for in-browser agents.
- [NRI & International Tax CA in Nashik](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/ca-in-nashik): Nashik office: Shop No. 12&13, Ram Plaza, Bhabha Nagar, Mumbai Naka, Nashik – 422011.
- [CA in Sillod](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/ca-in-sillod): Sillod office (NRI property sales, incorporation, audit): Near Datta Mandir, Tilak Nagar, Sillod – 431112.

## Core Services

- [US Cross-Border Compliance](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/us-cross-border): US LLC and C-Corp compliance for Indian founders (Form 1120, Form 5472, Delaware franchise tax, FBAR), ODI and FEMA for the Indian side.
- [Transfer Pricing](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/transfer-pricing): Documentation, methods, safe harbour, APA, audit support.
- [UAE Tax Advisory](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/uae-tax-advisory): UAE corporate tax structuring and India-UAE compliance.
- [NRI Tax Advisory](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/nri-tax-advisory): Property sale TDS, repatriation, DTAA, residential status.
- [Company Incorporation](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/company-incorporation): Company and LLP formation, ROC compliance.
- [Startup Advisory](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/startups): Virtual CFO services, DPIIT registration, fundraising compliance.
- [Offshore Accounting](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/offshore-accounting): Outsourced bookkeeping and offshore accounting teams for foreign businesses.
